bullets: Drive the strategy for the next wave of security products - market analysis, customer discovery, competitive landscape, and a clear recommendation on what to do first, second, and…
Build the business case for each area - the customer problem, market size, why Cribl can win, build / partner / buy options, and what it takes to get there.
Lead execution for what we fund - define the product, write the requirements, set success metrics, and drive delivery with engineering from 0 to 1 and beyond.
Make it one platform - make sure new capabilities work natively with Cribl Detect (shared data model, detections, alerts, and workflows), not as a set of separate tools.
Spend real time with customers - CISOs, SOC managers, detection engineers, and analysts - and work with design partners to validate direction before we commit.
Iterate with PM leads as well as peer PMs to prioritize features and present a coordinated roadmap across multiple dimensions of product and functionality
Negotiate with Engineering Management for feature prioritization in the context of available of resources and competing requests
Present roadmaps and investigate use cases with customers and partners
Triage and prioritize incoming feature requests, bug reports, and project ideas
Maintain development team backlog in light of company strategy and team goals
